description: This file contains API route definitions for managing habits, including CRUD operations, marking habits as complete, and retrieving completion records. It leverages FastAPI for endpoint declaration and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

methods.name: get_habit(habit_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))

methods.description: Deletes a habit and its completions.

methods.name: complete_habit(habit_id: int, completed_date: date = Query(None, description="Date to mark as complete (default: today)"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))

methods.name: get_completions(habit_id: Optional[int] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves completion records for the user, optionally filtered by habit.
